Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

be bored verb

also bored, boring, fed up, sick of it, I’m bored, sick and tired, I am sick and tired of

classical

Traupman 96, 107

taedet

verb, impersonal · Conjugation on Wiktionary

I’m bored, fed up

Other words

  • pertaedet — I’m bored, fed up

    verb, impersonal · also used · classical · Traupman 96, 107; Nep. Att. 15.2: negōtiī (pertaesum est; Lewis & Short); Plaut. Most. 1.4.4: mē sermōnis pertaesum est (Lewis & Short) · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Examples

  • taedet jam audīre eadem mīliēns

    I’m sick of hearing the same thing a thousand timesTer. Ph. 487

  • Taedetne tē?

    Are you bored?composed

  • Mē negōtī pertaedet.

    I’m sick and tired of the business.Traupman 107

  • Pertaedet jam audīre eadem identidem.

    I’m sick and tired of hearing the same thing over and over.Traupman 107

  • Mē negōtī valdē pertaedet.

    I am sick and tired of the business.Traupman 378

  • Mē valdē pertaedet jam audīre eadem identidem.

    I am sick and tired of hearing the same thing over and over.Traupman 378

See also grumpy.
